notes: Ex ante linear-programming (Excel Solver) study of seven cropping-pattern scenarios for the 60-ha Mekabo irrigation scheme, Tigray. Carbon farming = alley cropping (crops under mango/papaya), 'multi-species-cover cropping' (intercropping) and no-till; all sequestration rates and the US$10 credit price are assumed from other (mostly non-Ethiopian, web) sources. Kept in because the scenario revenues are the paper's own model results (data_type modelled), but evidence quality is very low: the practices have no yield or cost effect in the model, so the economic contrast is only added carbon revenue. Practice mapping is loose: 'alley cropping' is fruit-tree intercropping, no-till lacks residue info (partial_bundle), multi-species cover cropping is harvested intercropping (other). Not extracted: scenarios 1, 2 and 6 (no carbon farming; Gross Return 347,300 / 176,974 / 177,411 ETBirr/ha/year) because they are not a practice contrast; carbon sequestration t/ha/yr (Table 8) as it is not carbon income.
